question: What are the titles of all the movies that played at the Odeon or Imperial theater?
statements: CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE "movies" AS SELECT "code" AS "code", "movie_title" AS "movie_title", "rating_code" AS "rating_code" FROM table_1;
CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE "theaters" AS SELECT "code" AS "code", "movie" AS "movie", "name_part1" AS "name_part1", "name_part2" AS "name_part2" FROM table_2;

CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE materializer_assumption_check AS
WITH expected AS (
    SELECT 'movies' AS table_name, 'code, movie_title, rating_code' AS expected_cols UNION ALL
    SELECT 'theaters', 'code, movie, name_part1, name_part2'
), actual AS (
    SELECT 'movies' AS table_name, 'code, movie_title, rating_code' AS actual_cols UNION ALL
    SELECT 'theaters', 'code, movie, name_part1, name_part2' AS actual_cols
)
SELECT e.table_name, e.expected_cols, a.actual_cols
FROM expected e
JOIN actual a USING(table_name)
CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE movies AS SELECT code, movie_title, rating_code, CAST(NULL AS TEXT) AS columns FROM movies
CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE theaters AS SELECT code, movie, name_part1, name_part2, CAST(NULL AS TEXT) AS columns FROM theaters

CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE conductor_s_execution AS
WITH theater_names AS (
    SELECT 
        code,
        TRIM(COALESCE(name_part1,'') || CASE WHEN name_part2 IS NULL OR name_part2='' THEN '' ELSE ' ' || name_part2 END) AS theater_name
    FROM table_2
), filtered_codes AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT code
    FROM theater_names
    WHERE LOWER(theater_name) IN ('odeon','imperial')
       OR LOWER(name_part1) IN ('odeon','imperial')
       OR LOWER(COALESCE(name_part2,'')) IN ('odeon','imperial')
)
SELECT DISTINCT m.movie_title AS title
FROM table_1 m
JOIN filtered_codes f USING(code)
ORDER BY title

CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE conductor_s_execution AS
WITH theater_names AS (
    SELECT 
        code,
        -- concatenate without space because samples show split like 'Im' + 'perial' and 'Od' + 'eon'
        LOWER(TRIM(COALESCE(name_part1,'') || COALESCE(name_part2,''))) AS theater_name_norm
    FROM theaters
), filtered_codes AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT code
    FROM theater_names
    WHERE theater_name_norm IN ('odeon','imperial')
)
SELECT DISTINCT m.movie_title AS title
FROM movies m
JOIN filtered_codes f USING(code)
ORDER BY title
